records.issue_text: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:31 — One malformed or failing feed item aborts the whole batch and retry:false drops all later items until the next poll.
records.rationale: The diff shows `sidekiq_options retry: false` and `rss.items.each` with no rescue/begin-per-item in poll_feed. Any exception while processing one item (e.g., from `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)`, `i.content.scrub`, or `TopicEmbed.import` → PostCreator/PostRevisor) aborts the loop, so remaining feed items are skipped and the job won't retry until the next hourly recurrence. Mechanism fully verifiable in the diff.

records.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:12 — The case-sensitive scheme check rejects valid uppercase HTTP(S) URLs after URI accepts them, leaving those embeds permanently on the loading page.
records.rationale: The diff shows TopicEmbed.import returns unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//, a case-sensitive regex. Uppercase-scheme URLs (e.g. 'HTTP://...'), which URI parsing elsewhere in this code (TopicRetriever, absolutize_urls) would accept, would silently fail import and never create the embed, leaving the loading page reloading. Mechanism is verifiable from the diff, though it's an edge case.

records.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — RSS content is stored as raw_html and later rendered unsanitized, allowing a compromised feed to persist script execution for forum visitors.
records.rationale: The mechanism is verifiable in the diff: Jobs::PollFeed.fetch fetches external RSS content, TopicEmbed.import creates posts with cook_method: raw_html, Post#cook then returns raw unsanitized (`return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`), and best.html.erb renders `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. No sanitization step (e.g. Sanitize/nokogiri cleanup) appears anywhere in the pipeline, so script in a feed is stored and executed for visitors of the embedding page — a real XSS introduced by this change.
records.stripped_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — RSS content is stored as raw_html and later rendered unsanitized, allowing a compromised feed to persist script execution for forum visitors.

records.issue_text: app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb:11 — Passing the full referrer URL to postMessage makes the target origin invalid, so normal embeds never send their resize notification and remain clipped.
records.rationale: The layout code sends `parent.postMessage({...}, '<%= request.referer %>')`. The finding claims a full referrer URL is an invalid postMessage targetOrigin, so resize never works. Per the HTML spec, postMessage's targetOrigin may be any valid URL; it is parsed and only the origin is compared with the parent window's origin. A full URL like 'http://eviltrout.com/article' is a valid URL and matches a parent on http://eviltrout.com, so the described mechanism (invalid targetOrigin, no resize) does not occur.
